prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production animation pose pair derived from the supplied generated canonical design sheet.
Exactly TWO separate complete full-body drawings side by side on one flat pure chroma-green RGB(0,255,0) canvas, one drawing per half. Each drawing contains exactly ONE Cyrene and exactly ONE small memory spirit; no extra people, duplicate spirits, cropped hair, cropped shoes, text, logo, UI, checkerboard, floor or cast shadow. Keep a clean green gap between the two drawings and generous green margins around hair, dress, spirit, petals and ripple effects.
Unofficial fan-made Cyrene (昔涟), refined semi-chibi about 4 heads tall: mature gentle face, violet eyes, voluminous waist-length pink hair with blue-lilac tips, white laurel crown, blue-violet rose ornament, pearl-white and star-violet asymmetric dress, ice-blue crystal accents and pale shoes. Preserve identical head size, face, hair silhouette, compact limbs and the same signature outfit in both drawings and every state.
The pink-and-white long-eared memory spirit is 36 to 42 percent of her head height, with blue eyes, fluffy tail and gold-pink neck jewel. Keep it on a clear oval orbit to her right and never across her face, hands, chest or skirt center.
Effects are rich but controlled: rear star tide and petals, same-plane blue-violet rose light shards, and brief foreground ripple highlights. Keep the face and white dress readable; no large pink fog. Crisp premium cel-shaded anime linework, clean hands and coherent hair locks.
LEFT DRAWING: Thoughtful head tilt toward viewer-right, cheek still supported and rose steady; spirit points toward a small memory shard beside the rose.
RIGHT DRAWING: Gaze scans downward as if reading the next detail; spirit follows the gaze without crossing her hands or chest.
Only these two animation drawings. Keep transparent-effect shapes fully separated from the green border and preserve the same character scale.
